entities.summary: Muslim, a notable figure in the history of Gambia, associated with Senegambian Jihads and Soninke-Marabout Wars (1850–1901). Preceded by Soninke-Marabout Wars. Their legacy influenced Maba Diakhou Ba Jihad 1861 and Maba Diakhou Bâ Jihad.
